description: Truthiness assertions. The existence relation is satisfied when the actual value is truthy (any non-zero number, non-empty object or array, non-empty string, etc.) and reports a violation for falsy values (zero, null, the absent/undefined value). The negated relation is the mirror image: satisfied for falsy values, violated for truthy ones. A violation carries a diagnostic that renders the offending value. An absent actual field denotes the undefined value.
